## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline manual compaction command - NEW MEDIUM PRIORITY (command + core)

- **What**: Cline PR #14770 "feat(desktop): add /compact slash command" merged 2026-10-02. Adds `/compact` slash command (desktop composer slash menu) that triggers manual core compaction: summarize transcript with `core.compact()` and persist result as session's compaction state without sending literal summarization text to model. Runs in sidecar (same execution context as CLI local commands), respects session's `baseUrl` and `headers` via `buildSessionConnectionUpdate`. User can force compaction before hitting context limit, inspect compaction state, or compress history for export/archival. Desktop-only feature (slash menu in Electron/React composer), but core pattern applies to CLI.

- **Why**: **Alexi has automatic compaction** (`src/core/compaction.ts` 31K lines) with context-window-triggered pruning + tool output truncation + message merging, but lacks manual trigger command. Users cannot force compaction before hitting limit (useful for long sessions, pre-export cleanup, or testing compaction behavior), inspect compaction state (audit what was summarized), or manually compress history for archival. Cline pattern: manual `/compact` command (desktop slash menu, CLI could use local command like `/status`, `/help`) that calls `session.compact()` and persists result. **Alexi already has session manager** (`src/core/sessionManager.ts` 51K lines) with automatic compaction infrastructure - need to expose manual trigger as CLI command or TUI action. MEDIUM PRIORITY ~3-4h (add `compact` local command to CLI command registry, wire to `sessionManager.compactSession()` or similar, expose current compaction state in `/status` output or new `/compact --status` flag, add test case, verify no double-compaction when manual trigger + auto trigger both fire).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14770 (Cline /compact command, merged 2026-10-02, 2 commits: "feat(desktop): add /compact slash command" + "fix(desktop): forward session baseUrl and headers to /compact"), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/compaction.ts (automatic compaction, 31527 bytes), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/sessionManager.ts (session lifecycle, 51342 bytes)

- **Category**: command (new local command) + core (manual compaction trigger)

- **Size**: SMALL ~3-4h (add `compact` local command to `src/cli/commands/chat.ts` or new `src/cli/commands/compact.ts` following pattern of `status` / `help` local commands, wire to session manager's compaction infrastructure via `sessionManager.compactSession()` or direct call to `compaction.ts` exported function, expose current compaction state in command output or `/status` output, add unit test in `src/core/__tests__/compaction.test.ts` or `tests/compaction.test.ts`, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green, test manual compaction in running session via `alexi chat` then `/compact`, verify no double-compaction when manual + auto both trigger)

#### 2. Cline prompt draft persistence - NEW LOW PRIORITY (tui)

- **What**: Cline PR #14645 "fix(desktop): preserve prompt drafts when switching sessions" merged 2026-10-02. Stores in-progress prompt input text per-session so switching away from session A (with unsent text in composer) and back preserves draft. Desktop uses localStorage keyed by session id. Guards draft recovery (check session id match before restoring) and reuses session thread state for persistence. Prevents accidental draft loss when navigating between sessions in desktop sidebar.

- **Why**: **Alexi TUI** (`src/cli/tui/` with Ink + React 19) uses `ink-text-input` for prompt input with per-render state - no draft persistence across session switches. When user types prompt in TUI interactive mode, switches to another session (if TUI supports multi-session, or restarts CLI), then returns, draft text is lost. Cline pattern: per-session draft persistence keyed by session id. For CLI, localStorage equivalent is session-scoped temp file or in-memory session context. Low priority for pure CLI (single session per process, less switching), but valuable for TUI multi-session workflows (if implemented) or future desktop-like sidebar. LOW PRIORITY ~2-3h (add draft persistence to TUI input component, store per session id in session context or temp file under `~/.alexi/drafts/<session-id>.txt`, restore on session switch, guard against mismatched session id, add test case).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14645 (Cline prompt draft persistence, merged 2026-10-02, 2 commits: "fix(desktop): preserve prompt drafts when switching sessions" + "fix(desktop): guard draft recovery and reuse session threads"), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/ (TUI components with Ink + React 19, no draft persistence visible in file list)

- **Category**: tui (prompt input persistence)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (add draft persistence to TUI input component in `src/cli/tui/components/` or `src/cli/interactive.ts`, store draft text per session id in session context object or temp file `~/.alexi/drafts/<session-id>.txt`, restore on session switch via `useEffect` or session load hook, guard against mismatched session id before restoring draft, clear draft on send, add unit test in `src/cli/__tests__/` or integration test, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green)
